Thank you for taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review and for being a patient with us for many years. We're really pleased to hear that your recent visit to reception was a positive experience and that you found our team kind, polite, and efficient. Creating a supportive and welcoming environment for both patients and staff is very important to us, so your comments mean a lot.

We also appreciate your feedback regarding the difficulty in getting through by phone and the availability of appointments. We understand how frustrating this can be, especially for patients who are working during the day. Your suggestion about later appointments is very helpful, and we will certainly take this feedback into consideration as we continue to review and improve our appointment system.

Our dad is recovering from a heart attack, and our mum has serious mobility issues due to her knees — so I (as his 28-year-old sister) attended the appointment to support him. He was completely comfortable with me being there and explained our family situation clearly, but Dr Mehra refused to accept it.

From the moment we arrived, he was cold and dismissive — no greeting, no kindness. He kept repeating that “the law” only allows parents to attend, even though in many situations, a responsible adult family member is acceptable if the child is willing and understands what’s going on. My brother is 12, mature, and wanted me there, but the doctor wouldn’t listen and made everything more stressful.

He eventually treated my brother, but with a bad attitude — unfriendly, impatient, and completely lacking empathy. This is not how children especially ones already dealing with family stress  should be treated by any doctor.

I do not recommend Dr Mehra to anyone looking for respectful or compassionate care. If you want a GP who listens and understands, especially with young patients, I suggest booking with Matt Johnson — a great doctor and a true listener

Follow-up to my review:

Thank you for your response and for acknowledging my concerns.

I fully understand and respect the need for medical professionals to follow guidelines, especially when it comes to treating minors. However  my issue was never with the policy itself but with how the situation was handled by Dr Mehra on the day.

If specific documentation or parental consent was required this could have been explained in a calm and respectful manner I would have been more than willing to provide what was needed even something as simple as a quick FaceTime call to our parents for verbal confirmation could have resolved the matter smoothly. Instead we were met with a cold dismissive attitude from the very beginning which added unnecessary stress for both me and my 12-year-old brother.

I appreciate that Dr Mehra has many years of experience, and I do not question his clinical expertise. However, experience does not excuse a lack of empathy especially when dealing with a child already under emotional pressure due to family circumstances. How a situation is handled is just as important as the outcome, and in this case I truly believe it could have been managed with more understanding and compassion.

I am someone who is calm and reasonable, and I would have appreciated a more human, considerate approach. That’s all we were asking for.

Thank you again for your time 🙏",null,[0,160]]]],[null,1751390323000000,1751390323000000,"8 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/12403239176000890610/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVPYWxwSVVuRk5XRlpRVFVVNWRrMHlaSGxTYkRoNlpEQXhVazlGUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/12403239176000890610/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVPYWxwSVVuRk5XRlpRVFVVNWRrMHlaSGxTYkRoNlpEQXhVazlGUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/12403239176000890610/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVPYWxwSVVuRk5XRlpRVFVVNWRrMHlaSGxTYkRoNlpEQXhVazlGUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/12403239176000890610/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVPYWxwSVVuRk5XRlpRVFVVNWRrMHlaSGxTYkRoNlpEQXhVazlGUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/12403239176000890610/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVPYWxwSVVuRk5XRlpRVFVVNWRrMHlaSGxTYkRoNlpEQXhVazlGUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/12403239176000890610/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVPYWxwSVVuRk5XRlpRVFVVNWRrMHlaSGxTYkRoNlpEQXhVazlGUlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Yusra,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re truly sorry to hear about your recent experience at West Point Medical Centre and the distress it caused you and your brother. Your concerns are important to us, and we appreciate you bringing them to our attention.

First and foremost, we hope your father is recovering well.

We regret that your interaction with Dr Mehra did not meet your expectations for compassionate and respectful care. Our goal is always to provide a warm, professional, and empathetic environment for all patients, particularly children and families under stress. 

Regarding the matter of accompaniment, our clinicians are required to follow specific medical and legal guidelines when treating minors. As we did not have documentation confirming you as a person with legal responsibility for your brother’s care, we were unable to discuss his medical needs in detail. These protocols are in place to protect patient confidentiality and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. However, we acknowledge this should have been communicated with greater clarity and sensitivity, and we apologise if it caused any distress.

Dr Mehra is a highly experienced GP who has been part of our team for over 15+ years. He brings a broad range of clinical expertise and has earned the trust and appreciation of many of our patients over the years. We are confident in his professional standards and commitment to patient care, though we also take all concerns seriously and review them thoroughly.

If you would be open to discussing your experience further, we welcome you to contact our Practice Manager at 0161-248 5100, as we are always striving to improve the quality of care we provide.

Kind regards,

Maulik Shah
Practice Manager

My sincere apologies for the unpleasant experience you had with the practice.

Our policy is that patients should not arrive more than five minutes before their appointment time. I can see from your feedback that you arrived 30 minutes early and counted that as your waiting time. This is not fair when writing your review.

Although we have a sufficient number of clinical staff to meet the demand, some patients do not cancel the appointments and do not attend, which results in many appointments being wasted. We have already begun removing these patients from our database.

As far as treatment is concerned, each doctor has their own opinion and judgment regarding the patient's condition. If you disagree with their opinion, we suggest you seek a second opinion by visiting a walk-in clinic or hospital.

I am sorry to see you leaving, particularly when we are welcoming new patients. Here is some feedback we received from our patients about the services we provide to our patients and our locality. (hard copy available in practice).

"The Doctors take their time to listen and explain. Reception staff are friendly and helpful. My children always get on the day appointments and today I also got an on the day appointment" 

Thank you.
